user.title: Stopfinder – Sign In
user.description:
Enter your Stopfinder (Transfinder) account credentials.

**Note:** This integration uses undocumented Transfinder mobile APIs that are not officially supported for third-party use and may change or break without notice.

data_description.user_agent: Optional custom User-Agent header sent to the Stopfinder API. Leave as default unless directed otherwise.

preferences.title: Tracking Preferences
preferences.description:
Detected bus: **{bus_number}**

Configure polling and early-release thresholds. GPS is fetched only during the active tracking window.

data_description.student_label: Name used for the device and entity IDs (e.g. 'Jack'). This is permanent — changing it later requires re-adding the integration.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to fetch the bus GPS position (seconds)
data_description.minutes_before: Open the tracking window this many minutes before the scheduled pickup
data_description.minutes_after: Close the tracking window this many minutes after the scheduled dropoff
data_description.halfday_hour: School pickup before this hour (24h) = Half Day. Default: 13 (1:00 PM)
data_description.early_hour: School pickup before this hour (24h) = Early Release. Default: 14 (2:00 PM). Must be greater than the Half-Day threshold.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to reach the Stopfinder API. Check your internet connection.
error.invalid_thresholds: Early Release hour must be greater than the Half-Day hour.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Stopfinder account is already configured.

data_description.zone_school: Optional – HA zone at the school. Stamps School Dropoff Actual (morning) or School Pickup Actual (afternoon).
